description: Gladstone trail is west of Peachland along the base of Pincushion Mountain. Elevation: 806 m / 2644 ft. Views of Okanagan Lake and the Peachland area.
directions: Access is off Hwy 97 onto Princeton Ave and onto Somerset Ave and onto Gladstone Road and onto Victoria Street and Harrington Road , with a parking area near the base of the hill side.
title: Gladstone
